title: Manager, Electrode Process Engineering, Operations
description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

#LI-Onsite

#LI-LN1

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

Description

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance. 

Basic Qualifications

title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. 

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development


What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) (m/w/d)
description:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

About Hyperscale Power

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical.

The role

As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale.

This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components.

What you will do

  • Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production.

  • Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts.

  • Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules.

  • Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues.

  • Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components.

  • Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors.

  • Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks.

  • Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners.

  • Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

What you bring

  • BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing.

  • Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing.

  • Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus.

  • Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships.

  • Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities.

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

What we offer

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder.

Onze gedachte

We werken volgens ons 6D Delivery Model. Als Customer Lead houd je de rode draad vast over alle fasen. Het zwaartepunt van jouw deliverywerk ligt hier:

DISCOVER, DEFINE & DESIGN

Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

DEVELOP & DEPLOY

Interesse?

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role

ElevenLabs runs a deliberately lean finance team across 10+ legal entities and 40+ countries. The stack is built around NetSuite, Stripe, Ramp, Deel, HiBob and Pigment, with a BigQuery/dbt warehouse underneath. We want a close where people review exceptions and agents handle the rest. You'll own that stack, from architecture and integrations to controls and vendors. This is a builder role, not a ticket queue.

  • Run NetSuite end to end. That covers multi-subsidiary setup, chart of accounts and segments, scripting and workflows, release management, and roles and segregation of duties as we build toward public-company controls.

  • Own the integration layer: Stripe, Ramp, Deel and HiBob into NetSuite, and NetSuite into the warehouse. Month-end should reconcile by design instead of by hand.

  • Lead selection and rollout of new systems, including usage-based billing and equity administration. You'll also handle the finance setup of every new entity.

  • Build with AI, alongside our Automations and Data teams. Examples include agents and automations for invoice coding, people-cost reconciliations and accounting requests.

  • Be the systems voice in finance decisions on new pricing models, new geographies and audit readiness.

Requirements

  • You've administered a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld instance yourself, including SuiteScript/SuiteQL, saved searches, roles and releases.

  • You've owned an ERP or billing implementation or migration end to end, and you know how Stripe data flows into the ERP and into revenue recognition.

  • You build integrations, through iPaaS or code, that reconcile and alert when something breaks, and you're comfortable in SQL.

  • You understand R2R, P2P and O2C and the controls behind them, and you can work with accountants, engineers and auditors in the same week.

  • You work AI-first: tools like Claude Code or Cursor are part of your day, and you automate a workflow before you staff it.

  • Bonus: experience with Ramp, Pigment, Metronome or another usage-billing platform, Deel/HiBob, or n8n, or dbt/BigQuery; SOX or ITGC work at a pre-IPO or public company.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead a Finance Systems & Automation team as the company scales.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in CET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Warsaw and London.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, EMEA
description:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.

Why this role

A significant part of Firstwork’s growth over the next few years will be determined by how successfully we build the business in Europe. Which markets we enter and in what order, how we price against the incumbents, which partnerships and investors are worth the time, and how the company runs once it is spread across two continents. Those decisions sit with the CEO, and this role sits next to him and the Chief of Staff.

You work in the Office of the CEO alongside the Chief of Staff, and you own the European half of the agenda. That covers the market entry plan and the work of actually executing it, board and investor material, the relationships with private equity firms and their portfolio companies that drive our largest deals, and the strategic projects that have no owner yet. One week that looks like a pricing model. The next it looks like being in a major city getting an entity live and a first customer signed.

You will learn how a company really works, quickly, and then get handed a piece of it to run.

What you'll do

  • Own the European market entry plan, from sequencing and targets through to entity setup and first customers

  • Build board, investor and strategic partner material with the CEO and Chief of Staff

  • Support the private equity relationships and the pipeline running through their portfolio companies, including the preparation and the follow-through

  • Run pricing, packaging and competitive analysis for the region

  • Set the operating cadence for the European team, meaning planning, metrics and the weekly rhythm

  • Localise go-to-market with Sales, Marketing and Product, covering messaging, contracts and how we position on compliance

  • Pick up the projects the Office of the CEO needs done properly and nobody owns

What we're looking for

  • Four to eight years in tier one strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or a strategy role inside a company growing fast

  • The ability to take an ambiguous question, build the model behind it, and write the two pages the board will actually read

  • Enough range to be useful to a PE partner, a CFO and a Head of Operations in the same conversation

  • A bias to finishing. Getting the entity live counts. Writing the recommendation doesn't

  • Experience across more than one European market, and a European language beyond English

  • A habit of reaching for AI and automation before spreadsheets and headcount

If you want the closest available seat while a company goes from one continent to two, this is the job.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Macclesfield, United Kingdom  (3 days on site per week)

 

About AstraZeneca

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening new ways to work, pioneering innovative methods and bringing unexpected teams together.

 

Lead the delivery of a global enterprise learning transformation portfolio, with the replacement of the global Learning Management System as the immediate and primary licence-to-operate programme. Alongside the LMS, you will oversee the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem, ensuring the programmes operate as an integrated portfolio and deliver measurable, sustainable enterprise outcomes.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions, you will lead the portfolio delivery function, integrating plans, resources, investment, risks, dependencies, decisions and benefits. You will direct Programme Managers and the PMO, establish clear delivery standards and priorities, and provide the assurance and executive insight required to keep this complex transformation focused and on course.

 

You will create an environment where governance enables timely decisions, risks surface early and interdependent programmes delivery at a global scale, shaping how learning services and technology evolve across the enterprise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio strategy, integration and planning: Define and lead the portfolio’s end-to-end delivery approach, integrated master plan, operating model, decision rights and pathways. Translate strategic priorities into sequenced programme outcomes, with the global LMS replacement as the immediate delivery priority, while maintaining momentum across Learning Content Services and the learning ecosystem refresh. Direct Programme Managers and the PMO, align resources and suppliers, and maintain robust baselines, and change control.

Global LMS delivery, compliance and operational readiness: Hold portfolio-level accountability for orchestrating and assuring the successful delivery of the global LMS replacement as a critical licence-to-operate programme. Direct integrated delivery across business, IT, Quality, data, suppliers, change and operations, ensuring effective control of validation, migration, deployment and operational readiness. Safeguard compliance, data integrity and service continuity, and enable a controlled transition to live operation and sustained adoption.

Content Services and learning ecosystem transformation: Lead and assure the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem. Ensure each programme has clear outcomes, accountable leadership, delivery plans and controls, and that technology, content, data, process and service-design decisions remain aligned across the portfolio.

Governance, assurance and systemic risk: Establish and implement proportionate governance, delivery controls, stage gates and escalation thresholds across the portfolio. Oversee risks, issues and cross-programme dependencies' end to end, resolving recurring concerns at source and raising material decisions and trade-offs with evidence-based recommendations.

Financial, resource and commercial control: Lead all aspects of portfolio budgets, forecasts, capacity and supplier performance, ensuring investment and resources remain aligned to delivery priorities. Partner with Finance, Procurement and People teams to handle constraints and variances and recommend timely trade-offs across programmes.

Performance, executive insight and value: Lead the portfolio performance and benefits framework, providing a forward-looking view of delivery, readiness, compliance, adoption and value. Translate complexity into clear choices for the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions and governance forums, and provide service owners with the evidence required for transition, operational acceptance and benefits realisation.

Organisational leadership and delivery capability: Build a high-performing Programme Management and PMO community with clear accountability and consistently applied delivery standards. Strengthen capability through development, organisational design and resourcing, while ensuring effective succession, knowledge transfer and delivery continuity.

 

Requirements:

Bachelors degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in programme management, project management, business, technology, learning, HR, organizational change, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or recognised programme or portfolio management certification is desirable.

Senior programme or portfolio leadership experience delivering complex, global, technology-enabled transformation.

Hands on experience leading the implementation or replacement of a global LMS, HR platform or comparable business-critical enterprise system, including delivery in a regulated environment.

Strong understanding of the delivery controls required for validation, data migration, compliance, operational readiness and transition of a business-critical global platform.

Ability to establish integrated portfolio plans, operating models, governance, performance management and execution at enterprise scale.

Experience leading a complex, multi-year transformation portfolio from strategy through to delivery, including defining the operating model, integrated master plan, decision rights, and governance.

Experience leading Programme Managers and PMO professionals, building organisational capability and delivering outcomes through others.

Experience integrating delivery across business, technology, data, Quality, suppliers, change and operations.

Executive presence and commercial judgement, with the ability to present evidence-based recommendations and make informed trade-offs.

 

In Office Requirement:

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
